claims.verbatim:
NEW YORK, June 16.—The City of Paris,
from Liverpool on the 5th, via Queenstown
on the 6th, has arrived.

claims.verbatim:
The Inman steamer City of Paris, from Queens-
town on the 7th June, has arrived at this port,
making one of the quickest passages on record.

claims.verbatim:
Steamship City of Paris (Br), Kennedy, Liverpool June 6,
via Queenstown 7th, at 5 PM, with mdse and 766[?] passengers,
to John G Dale. 15th inst, 6 AM, passed steamship Edinburg
and a bark rigged steamer bound E.

claims.verbatim:
The steamship City of Paris, from Queenstown on the
7th of June, reached this port at a very early hour yes
terday morning. Her news is four days later.

of Paris, dated to the 7th of June, with the financial
and commercial advices to the latest moment prior to
